capture.isolation: An owned postgres:16-alpine container with random loopback allocation and tmpfs storage, verified by the existing isOwnedCiPostgres ownership guard. Agent child received an allowlisted environment, private empty HOME and private data root; PM_DESKTOP_MANAGED=1 prevented loading checkout dotenv credentials. No user token file or native CLI account was imported.
capture.modelExecution: None. No Provider configured or selected; no message sent, generation started, mocked Provider, injected history or model response. Chat shows a real empty-history session, editable unsent draft and manually selected real PM task reference. 未执行模型；不代表Provider验收。
capture.securityBoundary: PM authorization and the Agent local operator identity are independent. Directory configuration is not a sandbox. Unified session persistence remains an unadopted candidate.
